clarification: The preregistration names fourteen trader-readable feature groups. Two groups contain multiple separately modeled numeric columns: completed returns contain 1m, 5m and 15m returns, and structural geometry contains upper and lower distances. The frozen model matrix therefore has sixteen numeric columns without adding a new economic feature family.
availability_rule: Every market feature ends at the last minute whose close is available by the completed source-bucket decision timestamp. The next-minute open is execution only and cannot affect feature values, row eligibility, side or expected value.
